exposure: Transvaginal three-dimensional ultrasound combined with color Doppler ultrasound (3D-US + color Doppler US)
outcome: Area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC)
cohort: Participants diagnosed with early cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who were randomly divided into two groups for diagnostic comparison.
finding: Transvaginal three-dimensional ultrasound combined with color Doppler ultrasound significantly improved the sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy of diagnosis for early cesarean scar pregnancy compared to transvaginal 3D-US alone.
mod_finding: N/A (The study is about diagnosing complications related to a prior cesarean section, but does not compare modes of birth itself.)
